jobs_results.title: Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
About MIGx

MIGx is a global consulting company with an exclusive focus on the healthcare and life science industries, with their particularly demanding requirements on quality and regulatory aspects. We have been managing challenges and solving problems for our clients in the areas of compliance, business processes and many others.

MIGx interdisciplinary teams from Switzerland, Spain and Georgia have been taking care of projects in the fields of M&A, Integration, Application, Data Platforms, Processes, IT management, Digital transformation, Managed services and compliance.

About the profile

We are looking for a data enthusiast who likes to play with structured and unstructured data, organize it and create useful dashboards for taking insights and value for it.

Project Description

We are working in several projects building Power BI dashboards that are to be powered by multiple data sources. You will be part of a bigger team in MIGx responsible for the Data Services and building... Data Products for our customers (mid to large size enterprises). You will have an opportunity to continue growing in the are of all things Data related. You will participate in building overall Data Mesh architecture for the customer while focusing on one specific visualization project and more upcoming.

Responsibilities
• To buid PowerBI dashboards
• To be able to configure and connect different data sources, in special, SQL databases
• To build data reports

Requirements - Must have
• Proficiency in Data Analytics and Data Visualization concepts
• 3+ years of practical experience with one of the reporting tools – Power BI (preferable).
• Skills in developing reports and dashboards
• Advanced SQL knowledge and background in relational databases such as MS SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, and PostgreSQL
• Understanding of landing, staging area, data cleansing, data profiling, data security and data architecture concepts (DWH, Data Lake, Delta Lake/Lakehouse, Datamart)
• Familiarity with Cloud technologies (Azure, AWS)
• Ability to work in an agile development environment (SCRUM, Kanban)
• Understanding of CI/CD principles and best practices

Requirements - Nice to have
• Experience in building ETL (Extract, Transform and Load) pipelines
• Experience with Azure Data Factory
• Experience with ADLSgen2

Languages
• English – B2 / C1

What we offer:
• Hybrid work model and flexible working schedule that would suit night owls and early birds
• 25 holiday days per year
• Possibilities of career development and the opportunity to shape the company future
• An employee-centric culture directly inspired by employee feedback - your voice is heard, and your perspective encouraged
• Different training programs to support your personal and professional development
• Work in a fast growing, international company
• Friendly atmosphere and supportive Management team

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Grafton es una multinacional dedicada a la captación de talento y a la búsqueda y selección de mandos intermedios y directivos. Somos parte de Gi Group, una de las multinacionales de referencia ofreciendo soluciones personalizadas de Recursos Humanos. Desde Grafton buscamos un Data Analyst basado en la ciudad de Barcelona para una compañía del sector alimentario que busca una persona para liderar el proyecto de BI.

Misión del Puesto:
• Será responsable de la recopilación, limpieza junto a su posterior análisis y visualización de datos de la empresa para poder proporcionar información para la toma de decisiones en las distintas áreas de la organización.

Funciones:
• Recopilar, limpiar y preparar datos de diversas fuentes para su análisis.
• Realizar análisis de datos para identificar patrones, tendencias y correlaciones significativas.
• Desarrollar modelos predictivos y descriptivos para comprender mejor los datos y prever resultados futuros.
• Crear informes y visualizaciones de... datos claros y concisos para comunicar insights a diferentes audiencias.
• Colaborar con otros equipos para entender sus necesidades analíticas y proporcionarles apoyo con los datos.
• Contribuir al mantenimiento y actualización de bases de datos y sistemas de análisis. Requisitos:
• Experiencia de al menos 2 años con Herramientas con Power BI / Tableau.
• Experiencia profesional demostrable con Python o R.
• Capacidad para liderar un proyecto reportando directamente a CTO

jobs_results.title: Product Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
🤷🏽♀️ LIFULL Connect...do you want to know more about us?

LIFULL Connect is a global marketplace group operating vertical search, portals, and transactions-based sites. Our mission is to help people make one of their life's biggest decisions: find a home. And how do we do it? Quick, easy, helpful. That’s our promise! ✋

Our products:
• Proppit: one of the leading marketing tools in the real estate market, that allows professionals to reach the largest audience, accelerate their sales processes, and save time.
• Thribee: is a traffic acquisition service where you can manage all your campaigns from all of our aggregators in one single platform, reaching more users and diversifying your sources of traffic.

And...what’s it like to work with us? We are a tech company with an innovative team and we are looking for team players who share our values:
• #Impact: have meaningful goals that allow us to improve as a team.
• #User Centric: truly understanding the users and creating meaningful... experiences.
• #People Care: understanding each other's motivation, aspirations, and needs.
• #Be your true self: embrace diversity and inclusiveness.
• #Growth Mindset: becoming better every day.

Do you want to learn more about us? 👉🏽 Click here!

🦾 Life in our team:

Our team is made up of 2 people and we are looking for a skilled and experienced Product Data Analyst to complete the team. 😎 The new colleague will help us make better decisions and come up with more interesting and innovative product ideas by exposing the right data and extracting business insights from it. All along the product development flow, this person will help us discover opportunities and validate that our products deliver the value for our users that we intend them to. 📉

💡 What you will do:
• Define and create powerful Dashboards to empower the rest of the product specialists and other stakeholders to better understand the performance of running products and features.
• Work with the data and use it to draw insights to support several phases of the product life cycle, such as discovery (supporting the Product Manager in understanding user needs), exploration (investigating that need in more depth), and product validation (analyzing the data to understand how new implementations are performing).
• Monitor the KPIs and product metrics weekly to help Product Managers and other stakeholders make fast decisions on the platform performance, test iterations, etc.
• Perform root cause analysis to explain and understand (sudden) changes in performance to support product decisions.
• Work collaboratively with other Product Data Analysts, Data Engineers, and Product Managers.
• Proactively communicate with stakeholders.

🛠️ You will work with:
• Visualization: Quicksight.
• Data Warehouse: MySQL – RedShift.
• ETL: DBT + SQL.
• Data Lake: Amazon S3.

🔎 What we are looking for:

❗Please keep in mind that, although we would love to meet you, to proceed with your application, a valid working permit for Spain is needed❗
• Strong business orientation and acumen.
• Proficient with SQL
• Flexible and used to working in agile environments.
• Used to work with short- and long-term goals and ability to meet deadlines.
• Open to feedback and an advocate for an accessible, diverse, low-ego approach to work.
• Good communication skills in English and Spanish languages.

➕ These skills are enough but...it will be a plus if you have:
• Self-driven mindset with the capacity to help grow the Product Data Analysts' team methodologies, flows, and tools.
• Experience in driving strategy, vision, and execution in collaboration with product managers and engineers.
• Experience with ETL tools and flows (DBT, Airflow,...)

😎 Some of the things that will help you to perform at your best (aka perks!):
• 🏠 Hybrid Model: You can work from your home in Spain or our offices in Madrid or Barcelona.
• 💶 Salary Range: up to €45.000 gross annually.
• 🏥 Private health insurance to support you to be at your best.
• 🧠 Online therapy to boost well-being.
• 📚 Online English lessons for all levels.
• 📙 Ongoing training & learning opportunities.
• 🏖️ Flexible time off. Enjoy public and bank holidays when suits you best!
• ☀️ Summer Schedule in August.
• ✈️ 25 working vacation days per year.
• ⏰ Half-day Fridays.
• 💳 Flexible Compensation Plan (through Cobee) with discounts on transportation, food, and kindergarten expenses.
• 📝 Tax Advisor for Spanish Tax Reporting every year (through Tax Down)
• 👪🏾 Fully Paid Parental Leave and Soft Landing scheme.
• 💻 All the equipment you need.

Talent comes in all shapes! That's why we promote equal opportunity to all, regardless of age, color, gender identity, medical condition, physical or mental disability, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic. We want to provide and ensure an inclusive experience, so please, let us know if there is anything we can do to support you.

Let’s talk! 📞

jobs_results.title: Senior Data Analyst - Operations Analytics
jobs_results.description:
This role is hybrid (2 days per week) in our Barcelona office

Who we're looking for:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Operations Analyst at Rover who is excited about independently owning complex, cross-functional projects from end to end. You will partner with senior business leaders on high visibility projects, relentlessly pursuing outcomes that directly influence the customer experience on the Rover platform. You will be seen as a thought leader on the team and across the organization, and should be comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy in identifying and solving business problems.

We want someone who is passionate about directly shaping Rover’s support experience. You should be excited about partnering with product and business leaders to identify problems in the support experience and generate solutions that scale with the business. You will be responsible for designing robust tests and sophisticated analyses that deliver strong, actionable... recommendations to improve our business. Examples of this include developing our strategy for multi-language global support, improving our self serve support experience, optimizing agent processes and workflows, assessing and improving how we measure support quality, etc.

In addition to concurrently driving several high impact cross functional projects, this person will also be responsible for creating new metrics to understand the performance of new business initiatives, developing reporting dashboards, and building data abstractions in DBT. Additionally, they will play a vital role in supporting AB testing and experimentation efforts, using statistical analysis to evaluate changes and drive meaningful change across the business.

Your Responsibilities:
• Partner with business leaders to identify and size problem areas, conduct deep and comprehensive analyses to better understand the problem and recommend solutions.
• Partner with our Operations Scalability product team to find opportunities to improve our customer experience and reduce our support costs through improving agent efficiency
• Develop strategies to both measure and optimize the organization’s efficiency, agent performance, and interactions with customers
• Serve as strategic partner and advisor to business leaders, responsible for making recommendations on investments and optimization strategies in key functional area
• Help build the team by mentoring junior team members on data manipulation and business partnering
• Support the construction of our reporting abstractions (built in dbt)

Your Qualifications:
• At least 6 years experience working cross-functionally with complex datasets to support organizational decision making.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Specifically, you know how to narrate analysis and results to business partners in a useful, concise, and meaningful way.
• You are extremely comfortable with taking ambiguous issues and structuring them into crisp business problems, and using those to develop and execute on a refined project plan with clearly identified deliverables, all with relative autonomy.
• Strong proficiency with SQL. You would feel confident reviewing code produced by other analysts and data scientists
• You have hands-on experience building out data abstractions using tools such as DBT or Airflow as well as a variety of data visualization tools (e.g., Mode, Looker, Periscope, Tableau, etc.)
• You can independently prioritize projects based on return on investment and own the end-to-end project management for our analytics deliverables
• You are excited to help build a team and mentor junior analysts

Nice to have:
• Masters degree in a quantitative field OR on the job experience with applied statistics.
• Ability to code in Python/R is a plus
• Hands-on experience working with customer service tool data sets (e.g., Zendesk)
• Hands-on experience running A/B tests and experiment design

Benefits of working at Rover:
• Competitive compensation
• Permanent contract
• Pension Plan
• Meal tickets through Cobee
• Generous PTO Allowance
• Private health insurance
• Discounted Gym Membership
• Bring your dog to work (and unlimited puppy time)
• Monetary help for adopting a dog plus yearly credit to use on our platform
• Flexible work hours, sometimes you’ll need to be in at certain times, but on the whole, we’re pretty flexible when it comes to managing workload and time
• Grab snacks, fresh fruit, in our kitchen to keep yourself going
• Regular team activities, including happy hours, game nights, and more

Who we are:

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

We believe everyone deserves the unconditional love of a pet—and at Rover, our mission is to make it easier to experience that love. Founded in 2011, the Rover app and website connect dog and cat parents with loving pet sitters and dog walkers in neighborhoods across the US, Canada, and Europe. We empower our community of trusted pet sitters and dog walkers to run their own pet care businesses on Rover with the tools and security of a global company to back them.

Headquartered in Seattle, Washington, we work closely with our teams in Barcelona, San Antonio, Spokane, and remote locations. We’ve got a reputation for being a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. We're an agile, fast-growing company, and our leadership comes from some of the world's most respected tech companies.

At Rover, our furry coworkers are just as important as our human ones—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. Along with making the joys of pet parenthood more accessible, we’re committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming community of pet people—and that starts with our employees

• Partner with business leaders to identify and size problem areas, conduct deep and comprehensive analyses to better understand the problem and recommend solutions.
• Partner with our Operations Scalability product team to find opportunities to improve our customer experience and reduce our support costs through improving agent efficiency
• Develop strategies to both measure and optimize the organization’s efficiency, agent performance, and interactions with customers
• Serve as strategic partner and advisor to business leaders, responsible for making recommendations on investments and optimization strategies in key functional area
• Help build the team by mentoring junior team members on data manipulation and business partnering
• Support the construction of our reporting abstractions (built in dbt)

Your Qualifications:
• At least 6 years experience working cross-functionally with complex datasets to support organizational decision making.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Specifically, you know how to narrate analysis and results to business partners in a useful, concise, and meaningful way.
• You are extremely comfortable with taking ambiguous issues and structuring them into crisp business problems, and using those to develop and execute on a refined project plan with clearly identified deliverables, all with relative autonomy.
• Strong proficiency with SQL. You would feel confident reviewing code produced by other analysts and data scientists
• You have hands-on experience building out data abstractions using tools such as DBT or Airflow as well as a variety of data visualization tools (e.g., Mode, Looker, Periscope, Tableau, etc.)
• You can independently prioritize projects based on return on investment and own the end-to-end project management for our analytics deliverables
• You are excited to help build a team and mentor junior analysts

Nice to have:
• Masters degree in a quantitative field OR on the job experience with applied statistics.
• Ability to code in Python/R is a plus
• Hands-on experience working with customer service tool data sets (e.g., Zendesk)
• Hands-on experience running A/B tests and experiment design

Benefits of working at Rover:
• Competitive compensation
• Permanent contract
• Pension Plan
• Meal tickets through Cobee
• Generous PTO Allowance
• Private health insurance
• Discounted Gym Membership
• Bring your dog to work (and unlimited puppy time)
• Monetary help for adopting a dog plus yearly credit to use on our platform
• Flexible work hours, sometimes you’ll need to be in at certain times, but on the whole, we’re pretty flexible when it comes to managing workload and time
• Grab snacks, fresh fruit, in our kitchen to keep yourself going
• Regular team activities, including happy hours, game nights, and more

Who we are:

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

We believe everyone deserves the unconditional love of a pet—and at Rover, our mission is to make it easier to experience that love. Founded in 2011, the Rover app and website connect dog and cat parents with loving pet sitters and dog walkers in neighborhoods across the US, Canada, and Europe. We empower our community of trusted pet sitters and dog walkers to run their own pet care businesses on Rover with the tools and security of a global company to back them.

Headquartered in Seattle, Washington, we work closely with our teams in Barcelona, San Antonio, Spokane, and remote locations. We’ve got a reputation for being a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. We're an agile, fast-growing company, and our leadership comes from some of the world's most respected tech companies.

At Rover, our furry coworkers are just as important as our human ones—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. Along with making the joys of pet parenthood more accessible, we’re committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming community of pet people—and that starts with our employees

jobs_results.title: Analista de Datos con Especialización en Power BI HIBRIDO
jobs_results.description:
¡Estamos en búsqueda de un Analista de Datos con experiencia en Power BI para un emocionante puesto en el sector energético! Si te apasiona el análisis de datos y la mejora continua, esta oportunidad es para ti.

Actividades Básicas:
• Proponer y garantizar el correcto análisis y seguimiento de datos en estudios del área.
• Evaluar y proponer mejoras mediante el estudio de datos, participando en soluciones operativas.
• Participar en grupos de trabajo para mejorar la satisfacción del cliente en procesos de Comercialización, Atención y Operación.
• Desarrollar estudios del área de Calidad Comercial.

Tareas del Área/Unidad:
• Definir, diseñar y gestionar estudios para medir la calidad de servicio de cliente en España y Portugal.
• Implementar nuevas formas de recogida de percepción de cliente en canales no tradicionales.
• Controlar trabajo de campo, tasas de respuesta, saturación de clientes, errores muestrales.
• Diseñar, revisar y proponer mejoras en cuestionarios y KPIs.
•... Presentar resultados de estudios, analizar e interpretar resultados.
• Comunicar y gestionar las necesidades de los clientes internos.
• Colaborar en el desarrollo del modelo de información online de Calidad Comercial.

Requisitos:
• Titulación superior en Estadística y/o Matemáticas.
• Experiencia mínima de 2 años en minería de datos y big data: Python, lenguaje SQL o SAS.
• Experiencia mínima de 1 año en BI y Reporting de datos: QlikView, Qlik Sense o Power BI.
• Experiencia mínima de 1 año en entornos distribuidos y uso de clientes de FTP.

Se Valorará:
• Titulación específica en Big Data, con máster, cursos homologables o certificaciones.
• Experiencia mínima de 1 año con CRMs.
• Experiencia mínima de 2 años en análisis de datos en entornos de Datamart/Datalake.
• Experiencia mínima de 1 año en definición y realización de informes internos y de dirección.

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Data analyst para trabajar con importante cliente en contratación inicial con KRELL.

DESCRIPCION

Ayudar a definir mejorar documentar y difundir directrices procedimientos y normas sobre análisis de datos. Entrenar y formara los equipos de Datos en Power BI y Modelo Tabular. Ser identificado como un referente en temas de Power BI. Apoyar la aparición y el advenimiento de un BI empresarial en un modelo descentralizado y desarrollar sistemas analíticos avanzados de producción. Estar en contacto con la comunidad de personas implicadas en la valorización de los Datos y apoyar su crecimiento y vivacidad

FUNCIONES
• Proporcionar directrices/mejores prácticas claras ycomunicables sobre datawarehousing modelado de datamarts cubos y reporting/dashboarding y uso de tecnologías subrayadas (AAS DAX PBI etc.) etc.
• Construir y hacer material de formación para usuarios avanzados y principiantes y aumentar la madurez general en análisis a través de AXA... Partners.
• Realizar demostraciones técnicas sobre casos de uso avanzados principalmente a través de las sesiones Guild. Apoyar la adopción de tecnologías procesos y mejores prácticas en los equipos de datos proporcionando experiencia ad-hoc y bajo demanda (fl ujos o modelado dedatos complejos rendimientos etc.).
• Auditar los desarrollos creados por los equipos de datos.
• Realizar intervenciones puntuales para los equipos de datos como miembro de los expertos ad hoc .
• Trabajar en el desarrollo despliegue yBAU de sus proyectos de análisis de datos.
• Apoyar a los equipos de datos en sus actividades diarias siempre que necesiten ayuda.
• Ser un actor clave en las ceremonias de scrum y asegurarse junto con los demás miembros del equipo de datos de que se respetan los pilares de scrum.

Must have skills
• BI
• Power BI
• SQL
• Inglés C1

Nice to have skills
• Azure DevOps
• Scrum
• Azure Cloud Datalake Databricks Spark o NoSQL DB

QUE OFRECEMOS
• Contrato indefinido en plantilla y puestos de larga duración.
• Acceso a compañía consolidada con proyectos a muy alto nivel tecnológico y en diferentes sectores.
• Encontrarás un entorno de trabajo dinámico e integrador.
• Trabajo remoto

Modalidad hibrida. Ubicación en Barcelona (Teletrabajo60 - presencial 40 .)

¡Te estamos esperando! ¡Inscríbete y da un salto en tu carrera!

Power BI
